d: The Head of Human Resources leads the people agenda for our ambulatory care center in Dubai. The role builds a skilled, engaged and compliant workforce of clinical and non-clinical staff, and acts as a trusted adviser to the CEO and senior leadership team. It also champions Emiratization and the development of UAE national talent in healthcare.
Develop and execute an HR strategy aligned with the center's clinical, operational and growth goals.
Advise leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, succession and change management.
Lead and develop the HR team and manage the HR budget.
Plan and deliver recruitment of physicians, nurses, allied health and administrative staff.
Lead the center's Emiratization plan and meet national workforce targets set by UAE authorities.
Build partnerships with universities, training institutions and national talent programs.
Ensure compliance with UAE Labour Law, MOHRE requirements and Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations.
Oversee professional licensing, credentialing, visas, Emirates ID and medical fitness processes.
Maintain HR policies, contracts, and audit readiness for healthcare accreditation (e.g., JCI).
Manage performance, compensation and benefits frameworks that are competitive and fair.
Handle employee relations, grievances and disciplinary matters with discretion.
Promote a culture of patient-centered care, engagement, diversity and retention.
Design training, CME and leadership development programs, including career paths for UAE nationals.
Run onboarding, competency assessments and succession planning for critical roles.
Oversee payroll, HRIS, attendance and rostering for shift-based clinical teams.
Report on headcount, turnover, Emiratization, cost and engagement metrics.
q: UAE National (Emirati) holding a valid Emirati identity; this is a mandatory requirement of the role.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
Professional certification such as CIPD, SHRM-SCP or SPHR is preferred.
10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 in a senior HR leadership role, ideally in healthcare or hospitality.
Strong knowledge of UAE labour law, DHA and MOHRE processes, and Emiratization policy.
Fluency in English and Arabic, written and spoken.
Strategic thinking and sound business judgment
Influencing and stakeholder management at executive level
Data-driven decision making and strong HRIS skills
Based on site in Dubai with a standard full-time schedule. Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be confirmed in line with UAE regulations and the center's policies.

d: KBR is a global engineering, technology, and professional services company supporting customers in energy, infrastructure, government, and other sectors. In Saudi Arabia, KBR contributes to complex projects that require strong technical expertise, disciplined execution, and a commitment to safe, dependable design. The company brings multidisciplinary teams together to solve challenging engineering problems and deliver solutions aligned with client requirements, applicable standards, and project objectives. KBR values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, and seeks to create an environment where experienced professionals can contribute meaningfully while supporting the development of the next generation of engineering talent.

KBR is seeking a Lead Process Engineer to guide process engineering activities for upstream Oil & Gas facilities design in Saudi Arabia. This senior position is suited to an experienced engineer with at least 15 years of relevant industry experience and a strong background in facility design, technical assurance, and engineering team leadership. You will coordinate process engineering work from design development through review and delivery, ensuring that technical outputs are complete, consistent, and aligned with project specifications, client expectations, and Saudi Aramco standards.

Working closely with project management, other engineering disciplines, and client representatives, you will help resolve design issues, communicate technical decisions, and maintain progress against established schedules and budgets. You will also mentor process engineers, promote sound engineering practices, and support a culture that places safety and design integrity at the center of project execution.
q: At least 15 years of professional experience in process engineering, including substantial involvement in upstream Oil & Gas facilities design.
Demonstrated experience leading process engineering teams and coordinating deliverables on engineering or project design assignments.
Strong working knowledge of process simulation and hydraulic analysis tools, including HYSYS and Pipenet.
Practical understanding of Saudi Aramco standards and their application to process design and technical documentation.
Experience developing, reviewing, and coordinating Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), calculations, and related design deliverables.
Ability to assess technical risks, resolve design challenges, and maintain design consistency across project interfaces.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in technical discussions and client-facing coordination.
Strong organizational and planning skills, including the ability to manage priorities, schedules, and work within approved budgets.
A relevant engineering degree or equivalent professional qualification in a discipline appropriate to process engineering.
r: Lead, organize, and coordinate process engineering activities for upstream facility design projects.
Guide and mentor process engineers, allocate work effectively, and encourage consistent, high-quality engineering practices.
Develop, check, and approve process design documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, calculations, and technical reports.
Use and oversee appropriate application of HYSYS, Pipenet, and other relevant engineering tools in support of design decisions.
Verify that process deliverables satisfy project requirements, applicable codes, client specifications, and Saudi Aramco standards.
Coordinate with project management, client representatives, and other disciplines to address interfaces and close technical actions.
Identify design risks and discrepancies, recommend practical resolutions, and help maintain overall design integrity.
Monitor engineering progress, resource needs, schedules, and budgets, escalating concerns through appropriate project channels.
Promote safe design principles and uphold KBR’s values, quality expectations, and project procedures throughout delivery.
x: KBR offers the opportunity to contribute to significant energy projects alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Team members can broaden their technical expertise, take on meaningful leadership responsibilities, and support the development of colleagues. Benefits and employment provisions are provided in accordance with the applicable role, local requirements, and company policies.

KBR is committed to fair and inclusive employment practices and considers qualified applicants without discrimination, consistent with applicable laws. The company values diverse perspectives and aims to provide a respectful workplace where employees can contribute and grow.
